nodes.description: Public state variable holding the WhaleSharkContract interface instance at 0xA87121eDa32661C0c178f06F8b44F12f80ae4E88; external contract reference used for balance lookups.
Public state variable holding the StakingContract interface instance at 0x5a20c57a7e76e967ED284b8894b26bEd8ef7e785; external contract reference used for staked-token queries.
Public view function balanceOf(address owner) that queries the external whale shark and staking contracts and returns the combined count of held and staked tokens.
Address parameter supplied by the caller and forwarded to both external contract calls.
Local variable receiving the return value of whaleSharkContract.balanceOf(owner).
Local variable receiving the length of the StakingInfo array returned by stakingContract.getTokensStaked(owner).
uint256 addition of numHoldingSharks and numStaked produced with Solidity 0.8.10 checked arithmetic before being returned by balanceOf.

edges.reason: The state variable whaleSharkContract is read inside balanceOf to perform the external balanceOf call and its result is required to compute the function return value.
The state variable stakingContract is read inside balanceOf to perform the external getTokensStaked call and its result is required to compute the function return value.
The caller-supplied owner parameter flows directly into both external calls made by balanceOf, influencing the returned balance.
Local variable numHoldingSharks is an operand of the uint256 addition, so its value propagates into the arithmetic result.
Local variable numStaked is an operand of the uint256 addition, so its value propagates into the arithmetic result.
The addition result produced by the unsafe_operation node is returned as the output of balanceOf.

normalization_plan.reason: The owner parameter is only a temporary input binding of balanceOf; it can be collapsed into the enclosing core function node.
numHoldingSharks is a short-lived local that exists only to feed the uint256 addition, so it merges into that core unsafe_operation node.
numStaked is a short-lived local whose only purpose is to be added, so it merges into that core unsafe_operation node.
